note: Culebra Municipio (72049) has no queryable zoning district polygons. The Junta de Planificación statewide calificación layers (cali_vige/0, Calificación/228, Analisis_cali_MIL1/7) hold 1.4M+ polygons with a municipio field, but zero features have municipio or barrio Culebra, and envelope queries over the county's bounding box return 0 features. The MIPR viewer folder returns 403. ZonasPR lists Culebra districts under RC-2023-E but offers only a viewer and parcel map, no service. ArcGIS searches turned up no Culebra zoning layer, only parcels, which are not districts and not official zoning.
